Part.name: Kontakt-5 ERA cassette
Part.description: Placeable reactive armour. One fixed cassette reacts once against eligible HEAT or APFSDS hits. Up to 45% less remaining HEAT penetration and 10% less APFSDS penetration; cheaper than Relikt. About 53.9 kg. Return to Edit to restore spent cassettes. Gameplay calibration, not exact historical performance. Spent passive collision and mass remain; no tandem simulation.
